Commentary.Commentary: Abbott was the pick of the bowlers for South Africa while Rabada too was good. The tourists' bowlers were put under pressure for the first time since day one of the first Test. They didn't bowl badly, instead it was some really good batting from the Australians who wore down the bowlers with patient batting. The lead of 124 could prove to be vital in the context of the game. EARLY TEA HAS BEEN TAKEN. Join us in a while for the second session.

A fine batting performance from Australia on a sporting Adelaide surface. Khawaja's marathon ton was the backbone of the Australian innings with notable contributions from skipper Smith and debutant Handscomb. There was a valuable knock from Starc down the order which allowed the hosts to stretch the lead past three-figure mark. The lower order dug in for Australia with the last four wickets adding 100 valuable runs.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the third day's play. Australia will want to press on the advantage. The lead of 48, though not threatening, is still decent and South Africa will want to wrap up the last four Aussie wickets at the earliest. There is movement in the pitch but the phase before twilight period is better to bat on. Khawaja, obviously, remains the key to the hosts' fortunes. The action isn't far away.
.....DAY 3, SESSION 1.....

The Aussies lead by 48 and after Starc started off in a jittery way, he has hung around and is stitching a crucial partnership along with Khawaja. The home side would look to stretch the lead past the 100-mark while the tourists would look to bowl them out as quickly as possible. It will be a stern test for the batsmen as you are never really in on this Adelaide track. Join us tomorrow for all the action from day 3 at 0900 IST. Until then, goodbye and take care!

You can call it Australia's day though South Africa came back well in the final session. The debutant, Peter Handscomb deserves a special mention as he scored his maiden Test fifty and looked solid. His foot work was decisive and he played fearlessly before Abbott nipped him out with a beauty! The Protea bowlers used the corridor of uncertainty to perfection and reaped good rewards. Khawaja has been terrific and has held one end up with his marathon knock.

Advances down the track and pushes it to the covers.
Floated on off, Peter uses his feet and jams it back to the bowler who half-stops it.
Tossed up on middle, Handscomb comes down the track and eases it to long on for a single. He is looking really confident out there!
Tossed up outside off, Khawaja lunges forward and drives it beautifully through the covers for a run.
A touch short outside off, cut to sweeper cover for a single.
Fullish outside off, Usman presses forward and pushes it through the covers for a single.
Tossed up on middle, eased off the front foot to mid on.
On a length on middle and leg, worked with the turn through square leg for a single.
Tossed up on off, Khawaja puts his head down and defends it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on off, Usman presses forward and defends it past short leg.
Full outside off, played with an angled blade towards point.
Quicker one outside off, Khawaja camps back and blocks it into the ground.
Wrong 'un on the stumps, defended with the spin to short leg.
Tosses it up outside off, Khawaja prods forward and defends it to the covers.
A touch short outside off, goes with the arm. Handscomb goes back and gets a bit of an edge past first slip. Couple taken!
Quicker one wide outside off, Handscomb looks to cut it but misses.
Floats this one outside off, turning in. Handscomb covers his off pole and pads it away.
Tossed up on leg stump, Handscomb uses his fet and clips it to short mid-wicket.
Pushes it quicker but is way outside off to make the debutant play.
Short and wide outside off, Peter rocks back and cuts it hard to sweeper cover for a couple.
JP DUMINY comes on to bowl.
Around off, Khawaja tucks it towards mid-wicket but finds the fielder.
Fullish ball outside off, Usman blocks it into the ground.
Tad short outside off, Khawaja slaps it towards point.
Fullish around off, Khawaja tucks it towards short leg.
Tossed up outside off, Khawaja prods forward and defends.
Yorker outside off, Khawaja misses it completely. The ball deflects off the keeper's pads.
FOUR! GREAT USE OF THE FEET! Handscomb is playing really well now. He dances down the track to the flighted ball on middle and leg and clips it through wide mid on for a superb boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A touch short outside off, Usman camps back and pushes it to the covers for a single.
Tossed up delivery on the stumps, Khawaja presses forward and blocks.
50 run partenrship up for Khawaja and Handscomb.
Handscomb uses his feet and pushes it to mid on for a brisk single.
A touch short outside off, Khawaja camps back and pushes it to the covers for a run.
FOUR! Poor fielding! Bowls a full toss on leg stump, Peter hits it away wide of mid on. The fielder comes running but lets it through him and the ball rolls to the long on boundary.
Khawaja camps back and punches it through covers for a run.
FOUR! SHOT! Shortish outside off, Khawaja rocks back and cuts it through backward point where Elgar misfields a bit and the ball races to the fence.
On a length outside off, Khawaja stays back and defends it to the covers.
Shorter and flatter on the stumps, worked with the spin to the leg side for a single.
Handscomb steps down the track and looks to play at it but takes it on the pads.
Tabraiz Shamsi to bowl from the other end.
This is good batting from the youngster! He steps down the track and eases it to long on for a single.
Shortish outsie off, cut to backward point.
Wide long off comes in place.
On the pads, nudged round the corner for a single.
Flighted delivery, Handscomb comes down the track and eases it to long off for a run.
Tossed up on off, Peter advances down the track and drives it to mid off.
On a length, spinning back. Khawaja turns it to mid-wicket for a run.
We are ready for the final session. The players and the umpires come back in the middle. Usman Khawaja and Peter Handscomb will continue their innings. Dean Elgar to bowl first up after Dinner.
...Day 2, Session 3...

South Africa's bowlers tried hard but weren't quite to able to create the impact they had in the previous session. It must be said that both Khawaja and Smith handled them brilliantly. The only real chance was when Amla put down a sitter off the latter but it luckily didn't cost South Africa much. Australia still trail by 50 but they know that they are a partnership away from bossing the Test match. Crucial session coming up with the lights about to take full effect. Join us in a while for the post-dinner session.

Australia's session as the hosts have set the platform nicely for getting a sizable first innings lead. Khawaja and Smith continued to pile on the runs with both looking set for a massive score apiece. Just when it seemed like it would be a wicketless session, a horrible confusion in running saw the Australian skipper depart. Khawaja marched on though, getting to his 5th Test ton in the process and has a confident debutant Handscomb for company.
Back of a length on off, Khawaja gets back and clips it towards mid-wicket for a single. DINNER BREAK TIME ON DAY 2.
Good length outside off, shaping away, left alone to the keeper.
Fullish on middle and leg, Handscomb shuffles and clips it through mid-wicket. Timed it sweetly and will get three runs for it.
Good length closer to off, good leave by Handscomb.
Length ball around off, defended solidly off the back foot to the off side.
Good length on off, blocked off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Drags it short and well wide outside off, Khawaja goes for the cut but cannot beat point. He's missed out on quite a few half-trackers in this innings.

Floated outside off, steps out and drives it firmly to short mid off. Sharp attempt from Bavuma at the bowler's end but Khawaja was in his crease. No proper back up and they get the single off the overthrow.
Fuller on leg stump, clipped in front of square for a brisk single.
Floated outside off, blocked off the back foot towards point.
Flighted outside off, pushed off the front foot towards point.
Drifting in on a length outside off, a bit of turn and bounce as Khawaja lets it pass.
FOUR! Finds the fence this time! Good length closer to off, Handscomb sits back and cuts it away through backward point to find the fence. Elegant strike from the debutant. 200 up for Australia.
Back of a length outside off, Handscomb looks to cut it away. Flies towards gully on the bounce where it is well stopped.
Good length closer to off, solidly defended from the crease towards cover.
Length ball around off, defends it solidly from the crease.
Short of a length outside off, Handscomb plays a nice back foot slap through backward point for a brace.
Drifting on the pads, Khawaja works it through mid-wicket for a single.
KYLE ABBOTT is back on for another burst.
Floated outside leg, nudged down towards fine leg for a single.

Risky shot but he pulls it off! Drifting in from around off, spinning in, Handscomb goes for the cut but it's too close for the stroke. Manages to get it away as he played it very late. The ball goes towards third man as they pick up three.
Floated outside off, Handscomb steps out and pushes it towards cover.
Slightly short outside off, cut away towards sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up outside off, defends it solidly off the front foot.
Floated outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Length ball outside off, shaping away, left alone to the keeper.
Good length around off, nipping in, Handscomb hangs back and defends it firmly.
Length ball on middle, blocked solidly from the crease.
Length ball around off, defends it well from the crease to cover.
Fuller on off, Handscomb blocks it from the crease towards the covers.
Full and around off, driven firmly back to the bowler.
Fuller outside off, no shot offered to that one.
5th Test ton for Khawaja.

FOUR! THERE COMES THE MILESTONE! Floated on a length outside off, a touch short and Khawaja rocks back to cut it through backward point for a boundary. Good ball to get when you are near the three-figure mark and Khawaja obliges with a fine shot. This has been a brilliant innings from the southpaw. Pumps his fists in celebration and acknowledges the applause from the crowd.
Floated outside off, Handscomb steps out and pushes it to wide mid off for a single.
Fuller outside off, Khawaja leans forward and pushes it to mid off for a single.

FOUR! SUBLIME SHOT! Full and outside off, Khawaja steps out into it and thumps it on the up through the covers for a boundary. Top shot and that sped away to the fence for a boundary. High quality shot from the southpaw. He needs to bat on and show more responsibility after the Smith mishap.
Full and outside off, drilled towards short extra cover where Bavuma makes a superb save.
Length ball well outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Fuller on middle and leg, flicked away in front of square for a single.
Fullish on middle, Khawaja shuffles and wrists it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Fuller on middle and leg, Khawaja gets across and clips it to mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length on middle, Khawaja gets back to flick but misses to be struck on the thigh pad.
Floated on middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, steps out and drives it straight to mid off.

Off the edge but safe! Drifting away from outside off, Khawaja gets back to push at it but gets an edge well past first slip as it goes to third man. Won't make the fence but three more to the southpaw.
Slightly short outside off, Khawaja gets back and cuts it but cannot beat point.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and defends it out.
Drifting away from outside off, Khawaja gets back and cuts it towards point.
Fuller on off, Handscomb looks to push at it but gets it off the outer half towards the off side.
Length ball outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Good length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
And again! Almost a return catch. Full ball and Handscomb almost drilled it straight back into Philander's hands. Just fell short of the bowler. The debutant must have had his heart in his mouth.
Almost gone first ball! Good length around off, shapes away late to beat the outside edge. Nervy start from Handscomb but it was a top ball as well.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a run.
The next debutant, PETER HANDSCOMB, comes out to bat.

OUT! CONFUSION AND SMITH GOES! What a waste of a wicket but South Africa won't mind it at all. Just what the tourists wanted. Floated on off, Smith pushes at it but the ball goes off the outer half to the off side. Wanted the single but Khawaja is hesitant from the start. Too late for Smith to return and he is not even in the frame as de Kock collects Philander's throw to whip off the bails. Huge wicket for the Proteas and a timely one as well. Smith is fuming as he walks off.
Drags the wrong 'un short around off, Smith looks to work it against the spin but gets an inside edge on to the pads.
Fuller on middle, Smith leans into it and clips it to mid-wicket.
Flighted on middle and leg, Smith overbalances on the flick and cannot beat mid-wicket.
The wrong 'un but on middle, Khawaja works it with the turn behind square for a single.
Floated around off, turns away sharply to get past Khawaja's edge. Some bounce as well.
Full and outside off, Smith leaves it alone to the keeper.
Length ball outside off, shapes away a bit as Smith shoulders arms.
Good length outside off, shuffles across and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, Smith makes an unusual leave.
Full and outside off, defended well off the front foot down the pitch.
Good length around off, chopped off the back foot on to the pads off an inside edge towards gully.
Drifting in on leg stump, clipped down to fine leg for a brace.
FOUR! SHOT! He's taking Shamsi on now. Floated on off, he charges down the track to that one and lofts it dead straight down the ground. This time it has enough legs to reach the fence.
Floated outside off, Khawaja gets back and jabs it towards point.

Beautiful shot! Floated outside off, Khawaja steps out to that one and lofts it straight down the ground. Easily over mid off and it goes to the deep. Big straight boundaries here and not much intent in running this time. Just a brace added.
Drifting in from outside off, Khawaja pushes at it. The edge doesn't carry to slip.
Floated well outside off, no shot offered to that one.
TABRAIZ SHAMSI is back on.
Good length outside off, Smith hangs back and defends it well.
Well outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Fuller on middle, Smith gets across and tucks it to mid-wicket.

Almost played on! Full and outside off, Khawaja looks to drive but gets a thick inside edge just past the stumps towards fine leg. Smith eggs his partner through for the third run as well. Good running, especially from the skipper.
Length ball on middle and leg, worked away to the leg side for a single.
Ripper! Good length outside off, shaping away late to whiz past Smith's outside edge.
VERNON PHILANDER is back on.
Drinks break...
Flighted on middle, Khawaja leans into it and defends it solidly.
Drifting in from around off, blocked well off the front foot.
Drags it short outside off, width again on offer and Khawaja cuts it to sweeper cover for a couple.
Flighted outside off, driven off the front foot to long on for a single.
A bit short outside off, Khawaja stays back and slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
Floated well outside off, driven through the covers for a brace.
Good length outside off, Smith doesn't offer a stroke to it.
Full and outside off, Smith leans into it and pushes it to mid off.
Back of a length outside off, Smith lets it pass to the bowler.
Good length outside off, nips in sharply, Smith doesn't offer a stroke to that one.

FOUR! WHAT A SHOT! Delicious! Fuller outside off, Smith leans into it and plays a crunchy drive through the covers on the up. Beautifully balanced stroke and the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Good length outside off, Smith doesn't offer a shot to that one.
Drifting in from outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Tossed up outside off, pushed off the front foot towards cover.
Drifting in on off, drills it down the ground to long on for a single.
Drifting in from well outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Flighted outside off, Smith leans into it and defends it well.
Flatter outside off, spinning away, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Short ball well down the leg side, easy leave for Smith.
Good length outside off, defends it well off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, another leave from the skipper.
Good length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
18th Test fifty for Smith.

FOUR! Shot! Fuller on middle and leg, Smith gets across to that one and flicks it away through mid-wicket to find the fence. Struck it really well and he too gets to the mini milestone. Fantastic knock so far although he's lucky to be still batting. Amla will be the most guilty man now.
Good length on off, Smith goes across to flick but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Fuller outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Floated on middle and leg, clipped behind square for a single.
Drifting in on middle and leg, Khawaja gets across and dabs it towards short mid-wicket.
Low full toss outside off, driven firmly towards extra cover.
Fuller outside off, dug out by Khawaja in time.
A bit short outside off, punched off the back foot to long on for a single.
Another bumper and Khawaja sits under the short ball.
Shortish outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Back of a length outside off, left alone by Khawaja.
Short ball this time from Rabada and Khawaja evades it quickly.
Length ball outside off, Khawaja makes a leave to that one.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.

DROPPED! What have you done Amla? Smith looks to play another bludgeoning drive to the full ball but gets a thick edge towards first slip. It flew at Amla who spills it and tries to take it on the second attempt but in vain. Huge reprieve for the Aussie skipper. Massive moment in the game as well. How costly will this prove to be for the Proteas?
Sweeper cover comes in place.
FOUR! SPANKING SHOT! Floated outside off, Smith leans into it and thumps the drive through the covers. Finds the gap to get a boundary. Cracking shot from the skipper.
Drags it short outside off, a bit wide and Smith goes for the cut. Cannot get it past point.
Loopy outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Flighted on off, driven strongly but straight towards cover.
Tossed up very full on middle, Khawaja jams it out in time.
JP DUMINY comes on to bowl. SA searching for the wicket.
Back of a length on off, Smith looks to work it on the leg side but is hit on the thumb before falling on to the track. It was quite close to the stumps.
Shortish outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Short ball on off, Smith goes for the pull but misses.
Length ball outside off, defended off the back foot.
100-run stand is up between Smith and Khawaja.
Good length on middle and leg, worked away down to fine leg for a single.

Drifting on middle and off, Smith hangs back and clips it in front of square for a single.
Switches to around the wicket.
Slider on middle and leg, worked off the back foot to the leg side.

FOUR! TERRIFIC SHOT! Drops it short and wide outside off, easy pickings for Smith as he stays back to cut it brilliantly through point to find the fence. Spanking shot from the captain. Runs coming quite easily for the hosts at the moment.
Flatter on a length around leg stump, worked off the back foot to square leg.
Flighted around off, Smith gets well forward and blocks it well.
Full ball on the pads, Khawaja nudges it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Length ball angled away outside off, Khawaja makes a leave to that one.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked away through square leg for a brace.
Short of a length outside off, another leave from Khawaja.
Good length just outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Full and down the leg side, Khawaja looks to flick but misses.
KAGISO RABADA is back on for another spell.

FOUR! BEAUTIFUL SHOT! Fuller outside off, Smith reaches out to that one and drills it past the bowler. Struck well and it beats past mid off to the fence for a boundary. The Australian skipper is on song now and moving nicely.
Fuller on middle and off, Smith goes across and works it to the leg side.
Tossed up wider outside off, beautifully driven through the covers by Khawaja. Protection in the deep and so just a single.
Flighted outside off, Khawaja leans into it and drives it to short cover.
Tossed up outside off, nice square drive but straight towards point.
Fuller on off, blocked off the front foot towards point.
Length ball closer to off, comes in sharply as Smith leaves it alone.
Good length around off, Smith shuffles and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Dug in short on middle, Khawaja controls the pull behind square leg
Good length closer to off, good leave from Khawaja.
Full and outside off, extended forward defence from Khawaja past the bowler to mid off.
Full and outside off, driven firmly towards mid off.
Floated on middle, Smith looks to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge towards the bowler.
Fuller on off, driven off the front foot towards mid on.
Drifting in from around leg stump, Smith thinks of flicking but makes a leave.
Darted on middle, keeps a touch low as Smith adjusts to defend off the back foot.
Flatter around leg stump, worked off the back foot to the leg side.
FOUR! Nicely played! Floated outside leg, Smith brings out the paddle sweep and gets it easily to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Positive batting this.
Full and outside off, fluent drive from Khawaja but straight to cover.
Good length on off, worked off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Good length angled away outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Length ball outside off, gets forward and pushes it towards cover.
Good length outside off, shapes away a bit as Khawaja makes another leave.
Full and just outside off, left alone to the keeper.
FOUR! Shortish on off, Smith goes onto his back foot and cuts it nicely through the backward point region for a boundary.
Landed around off, Khawaja tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Fullish ball outside off, turning in, googly actually, Khawaja defends it with soft hands.
Outside off, turning away, Khawaja tries to defend but gets beaten.
Shortish outside off, Khawaja cuts it straight towards the point fielder.
Landed outside off, Khawaja defends it into the ground.
Tabraiz Shamsi to bowl from the other end.
Fullish outside off, angling in, Smith gets a bit across and drives it to mid on.
Fuller length ball outside off yet again, Smith drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Fuller length ball outside off, Smith drives it superbly through the cover region for a couple.
Fullish again outside off, Smith leaves it alone yet again.
Fuller length ball outside off, Smith plants his front foot forward and shoulders his arms.
Good length ball outside off, Smith pushes it towards the cover region.
We are back for the afternoon session! Steven Smith will be at the striker's end, Kyle Abbott to bowl. Here we go!
...Day 2, Session 2...

The South African seamers were once again brilliant with Abbott leading the pack. He was not only economical but also struck vital blows to keep pressure on the Aussies. Rabada was comparatively less effective by his standards but generally the pace bowling was spot on. Shamsi hasn't quite got any purchase yet and we will have to wait till he bowls under lights to see if he can do any damage. Join us in a while for the vital second session.

Fairly good session for the Australians although they would have liked to lose a wicket less. The day started well for the Proteas as Abbott struck twice in the first hour. He removed the debutant Renshaw and then the big one of Warner to put Australia in a bit of trouble. Khawaja and Smith have resurrected things with a lovely partnership with the former having got past his fifty too. They have ensured that the hosts are the marginally happier side at the break.
Loopy on a length outside off, no shot offered to that one. THAT SHALL BE TEA ON DAY 2.
Drops it slightly short around off, Khawaja looks to cut but the room isn't quite there. Chops it to point.
Flighted on middle and off, Khawaja leans into it and smothers it.
Flatter outside leg, Smith goes across to flick but then lets it pass. De Kock doesn't gather it cleanly either and it goes towards fine leg. Three byes added.
Flighted on middle and leg, Smith whips it away and doesn't quite keep the shot down. Just short of backward square leg.
Tossed up outside off, Khawaja drives it sweetly towards wide mid off for a run.
Length ball outside off, Smith lifts his bat to make the leave.
Good length outside off, Smith gets across and leaves it alone.
Back of a length wider outside off, Smith was thinking of the cut but then withdrew his bat in time.
Length ball on middle and leg, whipped away down to fine leg for a single.
Good length around off, Smith walks across and glances it down to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, slapped off the back foot but straight to point.
FOUR! Freebie and punished! Juicy full toss and Khawaja is not going to miss out in this mood. Slaps it away through mid-wicket with aplomb to pick up another boundary. 100 comes up for Australia.
Drifting in from around off, Khawaja gets the exaggerated stride forward to block.
Flighted outside off, pushed off the front foot towards point.
Fullish on leg, Smith clips it with the turn towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Drops it on a length on leg stump, worked off the back foot just past short leg.
Tossed up very full outside off, Smith digs it out towards mid off.
Length ball outside off, Khawaja shuffles across and defends it off the back foot.
Good length on off, Khawaja camps back and defends it to the leg side.
Fuller on off, defended well off the front foot.
6th Test fifty for Khawaja.

FOUR! Shot! This is even better! Shortish around off, Khawaja stands tall and drags it through mid-wicket with an imperious pull towards the fence. Excellent stroke this and brings up his mini-milestone. Great knock, can he keep it going?
FOUR! Another superb pull from Khawaja! Dug in short on middle, he just swivels on the back foot and pulls it behind square to get the boundary. Excellent shot from the southpaw.
Good length on off, Khawaja gets right behind the line and defends it solidly.
KYLE ABBOTT is back on.
Sliding on leg stump, Smith stays back and works it to the leg side.
Flatter outside off, Smith shapes for the cut but gets a bottom edge on it.
Drifting in from around off, Smith blocks it from the crease.
Fuller outside off, Smith winds up for the drive but gets it straight to mid off.

Floated around leg stump, Smith looks to work it down the leg side as de Kock collects it well. Huge appeal from Quinton as he thinks there is a feather there. Smith is smiling and there isn't any other SA player supporting the keeper either. That came off the trouser.
Floated outside off, Khawaja pushes it just past cover for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.
50-run stand comes up between Khawaja and Smith.
FOUR! Top shot! Fuller on middle and leg, Smith shuffles across to that one and whips it away sweetly. Bisects mid on and mid-wicket well to get the boundary. The skipper is getting into his groove.
Length ball outside off, swerving away, Smith lets it pass.
Good length around off, Khawaja gets across and wrists it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller on middle, Smith shuffles and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
What a peach! Good length around off, shapes away very late to square up Smith. He is very lucky not to get the edge there.
Fuller and outside off, Khawaja squeezes it out towards the off side.
Flatter outside off, jabbed off the back foot to the off side.
Floated on middle and leg, Khawaja gets across on one knee and scoops it over his shoulder. Gets it well to the right of the keeper down to fine leg. Brace taken.
Floated on the pads, Smith works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on middle, dug out back to the bowler.
Loopy on a length outside off, Smith stays back to that one and cuts it through point. Didn't try to overhit it, just timed it and got a couple.
Full and on off, defended well off the front foot.
Good length outside off, Khawaja doesn't offer a shot to that one.
Fullish outside off, flowing drive from Smith but it comes off the outer half. Well stopped by Bavuma at point, cannot stop the single though.
Good length angled in on middle, flicked in front of square for a single.
Full and closer to off, Khawaja shuffles and defends it solidly.
Good length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped past short leg.
Fuller outside off, Smith presses forward and blocks it.
Beaten! Floated on a length outside off, straightens a bit after pitching as the ball whizzes past Smith's outside edge. De Kock for a moment thought there was a nick. Beautifully bowled.
On a length outside off, a bit of spin away, Khawaja plays it late and dabs it well past Amla at slip. Backward point gives chase as the batsmen come back for the third run. Great running.
Loopy and full outside off, driven nicely towards cover.
A touch short outside off, Khawaja sits back to that one to cut but chops it towards point.
First signs of spin this morning. TABRAIZ SHAMSI comes on to bowl his wrist spinners.
Length ball on middle, Khawaja shuffles and clips it down to fine leg for a single.
Length ball angled in on off, pushed off the back foot towards mid on.
Fuller outside off, Khawaja presses forward and blocks it solidly to cover.
Fuller outside off, Khawaja presses forward and defends it well.
Full and closer to off, watchful leave by Khawaja.
Back of a length around off, worked off the back foot to the leg side.
Full and outside off, Smith leans forward and defends it.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed towards point.
Sprayed way down the leg side, Smith loves the flick but cannot get bat on this one.
Back of a length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Full and on the pads, glanced down to fine leg for a single.
Length ball on middle and leg, Khawaja looks to push at it but the away movement with bounce beats the edge. Hits him on the thigh as the ball rolls to point.
Fuller on the pads, Smith clips it behind square for a brace.
Fullish on off, Khawaja shuffles and pings it past the bowler. Beautiful timing again and beats mid on to the deep. Three runs added.
Fuller and just outside off, blocked firmly off the front foot.

FOUR! Ferocious hit! Can't bowl short at about 129 kph and Philander pays the price. Khawaja swivels to hammer the pull over mid-wicket to find the fence. Khawaja slowly growing in confidence although the odd poke refuses to go away.
Good length angled in from around off, dabbed with an angled bat towards gully. It went off the outer half of the blade.
That wasn't far away! Good length angled in the channel outside off, Khawaja's feet go nowhere as he pokes at it. The ball jags away past the outside edge.
Fuller on off, Khawaja gets across and drives it sweetly past the bowler. Beats mid on to the deep as the batsmen take three.
Back of a length outside off, moving away a touch, left alone to the keeper.
Full and around off, angled in, Khawaja's strong wrists allows him to clip it between mid-wicket and mid on. A brace added.
Length ball angled in from outside off, Khawaja doens't offer a shot.
Full and on the pads, Smith shuffles and clips it through backward square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, defended off the front foot towards mid on.
Fuller outside off, driven firmly towards mid off.

FOUR! Hammered! First real aggressive shot from Khawaja. This was dragged halfway by Philander and the southpaw lifts his front leg to play an authoritative pull behind square to find the fence. Superbly struck.

The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. Makeshift opener Usman Khawaja along with debutant Matt Renshaw to resume their overnight stand. Huge session especially for the Aussies considering their inexperienced batting. VERNON PHILANDER to start proceedings.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the second day's play. With the declaration not having served its purpose yesterday, South Africa will want early wickets this morning. The first two sessions are relatively easier to bat on and Australia will want to capitalize although you are never in on this Adelaide surface. Should be another compelling day's play. The match is nicely poised currently. Day two action coming up shortly.
.....DAY 2, SESSION 1.....

With two battling sides and a fantastic pitch for this Day/Night Test, the action is only expected to get better in the coming days. Crucial day tomorrow as whichever side wins it could have their noses in front. Both teams have shared the honors today with nobody really taking the cake. Join us at 0900 IST for the second day's play. Until then, it's goodbye from us.

A fairly even day's play after South Africa opted to bat. There was enough movement on offer for the pacers but as du Plessis' ton showed, it wasn't impossible to bat either. The tourists recovered from a shaky position thanks to their skipper to post a par score. Hazlewood was Australia's star with the ball with a 4-fer. Faf's bold declaration was made with an intent to nip out a few early wickets by stumps but it didn't turn out that way.

The Australian openers have done well to survive the tricky period to stumps without being separated. Warner didn't come out to bat because of his absence during Australia's fielding due to injury. Instead, Khawaja came out to open and along with debutant Renshaw weathered the storm with relatively less trouble to calm the nerves in the hosts' dressing room.
